profile_text.body:
IBM, founded in 1911 and headquartered in Armonk, NY, is a publicly traded technology company (NYSE: IBM) with reported revenue of $67,535,000,000 for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2025. The company's OpenPages product is described on its site as a scalable, AI-powered governance, risk, and compliance platform available on any cloud or on-premises, offering modular components covering risk management, compliance, audit, and model governance. The site notes that IDC recognized IBM as a leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide AI-Enabled Financial Governance, Risk, and Compliance 2026 Vendor Assessment, and highlights a partnership with Citi to automate internal audit processes using AI and machine learning, which the company says saved thousands of manual hours.

IBM's tracked AI products include IBM OpenPages with Watson, a full GRC platform incorporating AI-specific modules, risk assessment, regulatory mapping, and Watson AI automated documentation, and IBM watsonx.governance, which covers AI lifecycle governance, model evaluation, monitoring, and documentation, including EU AI Act accelerators. IBM watsonx.governance was named a Leader in Gartner's first AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant in June 2026. The broader IBM watsonx platform is described as a model-agnostic enterprise AI offering that includes agent inventory management, behavior monitoring, and hallucination detection. The OpenPages site also references an OpenPages MCP Server intended to allow AI agents to create, query, and update GRC objects within governed automation frameworks.

The site held facts indicate IBM carries 220 law exposure entries associated with New York. No litigation cases or MCP server registry entries are recorded in the current held data.
